List items in tree order; --inbox lists the tasks still to sort

## Usage

```text
chainmail item list [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
# the inbox: tasks not yet sorted
chainmail item list --inbox
chainmail item list --under it_admin_work --state in-progress
# everything changed after revision 120, deleted items included
chainmail item list --changed-since 120 --output json
```

## Flags

```text
      --area string         only items whose area, their own or inherited, is this
      --changed-since int   only items changed after this revision, deleted ones included, in revision order
      --deleted             include deleted items
      --inbox               only the inbox: tasks with no parent
      --limit int32         rows per page, 1 to 500 (default 100)
      --no-ongoing          leave out ongoing items
      --ongoing             only ongoing items, the Admin initiatives
      --page-token string   continue from the previous page's token
      --state string        only items in this state
      --type string         only items of this type
      --under string        only the items below this one, not including it
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
